name: North Ridge
beta: The ridge is gained from either its north or south side via moderate scrambling between South Twin's true summit and a subpeak about a quarter mile northeast. Climbers moving between North and South Twin cross the Sisters Glacier southbound to a bergschrund below the ridge, then climb up (favoring snow over rock where possible) to the ridge crest and follow it, mostly Class 3, with some low-5th variations, to the summit. A 1983 party noted good rock climbing on 'Arrowtip Tower' on the lower part of the ridge for parties looking for extra pitches.
